variants.headline: A new government takes shape
variants.body: A new government has been formed in {colony}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: Formation is the beginning of governing
variants.body: The colony has a newly formed government. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.

variants.headline: New ministry, practical obligations
variants.body: Government formation has produced a new administration in {colony}. Solidarity includes fairness to {target}; an adverse outcome does not by itself justify every accusation made.
